ON THE 19 th OF JUNE, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 21572 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 RABI @ ANURAG PATEL S/O SHRI RAMLAKHAN PATEL,
 AGED ABOUT 20 YEARS,

R/O VILLAGE BHEDRA POLICE  STATION AND TEHSIL RAMNAGAR DISTRICT SATNA  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI AMAN PATEL - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION RAMNAGAR DISTRICT SATNA (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 .
( BY SHRI SATPAL CHADHAR - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)

This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER T h is i s firs t application under section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant relating to FIR/Crime No.45/2023 dated 07.02.2023 registered at Police Station- Ramnagar, District- Satna, for the offence punishable under Sections 342, 457, 376 and 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 5L/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 09.02.2023.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case because it is a case of consent.
He further submits that challan has been filed.
He submits that the applicant undertakes to cooperate in trial as well as investigation and would make himself available as and when required.
Trial will take considerable time to conclude.
Upon these submissions, learned counsel prays that the applicant may be released on bail.

sentences.text: O n the contrary, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the bail application on the ground that FSL report is positive; therefore, he prayed for rejection of this bail application.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case-diary.

According to learned counsel for the applicant, prosecutrix was aged more than 16 years at the time of incident and she has disclosed in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. that she was having consensual relationship with the applicant.
School record seized during the investigation shows that date of birth of prosecutrix was 14.05.2007 and date of incidence was 07.02.2023.
On the basis of date of birth, age of prosecutrix comes below the age of 16 years at the time of incidence.
No document to challenge this age has been filed by the applicant.
Looking to the age of prosecutrix, this Court is not inclined to allow this bail application.
Accordingly, this bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of applicant stands dismissed.

(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE pnm Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121864459/
